capability: A valid session replacement waits for the active provider/tool run to settle before the destination runtime is adopted.
pinnedSource: packages/coding-agent/test/suite/agent-session-runtime.test.ts:settles the active response before session replacement

pinnedPiExecution.command: npm exec --workspace=@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent -- vitest --run test/suite/agent-session-runtime.test.ts -t 'settles the active response before session replacement'
pinnedPiExecution.testResult: Passed 1 test; 11 unrelated tests skipped by the focused filter.
pinnedPiExecution.testBehavior: An extension tool blocks during an active response. switchSession aborts and settles the outgoing response before replacing the runtime; the persisted outgoing entries include the interrupted tool result.
pinnedPiExecution.temporaryCheckoutSetup: The disposable exact-pin checkout did not contain generated packages/ai provider catalog JSON. Forty-two empty generated catalog modules and a minimal generated manifest were created only in that temporary checkout so module imports could resolve. The test registers and uses its own faux provider; no catalog content is asserted. Tracked pinned source files were not changed.

assertions: A physical provider response is held after a partial assistant delta while switch_session targets a valid saved session.
The outgoing turn ends as aborted, followed by agent_end and agent_settled, before the switch response succeeds.
A prompt after replacement reaches the provider with destination history and without the outgoing partial text or prompt.

comparisonPolicy: Compare replacement and settlement ordering plus the provider-visible active history; provider protocol details and internal session records remain implementation-specific.
limitations: The pinned test exercises an extension tool blocked during a provider run, while the PiSharp process test holds a provider stream; both assert settlement before replacement.
This case does not cover cancellation during target loading, missing/corrupt targets beyond the existing PiSharp invalid-target regression, or every extension veto lifecycle.
